main.description: A bidder's liveness. The bidder rewrites this one record (rkey self) in its own repo every 60 s. A requester treats the bidder as online while createdAt is at most 5 min old, and leaves it out of discovery otherwise.

offering.description: AT-URI of the bidder's com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.offering record that this heartbeat keeps live.
